LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_DESCRIPTION.source: 沿着航线和商路传播的语言，常从别处借来词语。简短的词序能交代事情，重音和惯用语又给同一句话添上不同意味。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 沿着航线和商路传播的语言，常从别处借来词语。词序交代句中关系，重音和惯用语让同一句话有不同意味。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_ALDEN_DESCRIPTION.en: A language carried along shipping lanes and trade routes, quick to borrow words. Word order carries much of its grammar; stress and idioms give the same sentence different shades of meaning.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_VERESK_DESCRIPTION.source: 辅音密集，名词的词尾会随句中角色变化。诗歌与书信保留着丰厚的书面传统，日常交谈则爱用昵称拉近距离。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_VERESK_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 辅音密集，名词的词尾会随句中角色变化。诗歌与书信保留着丰厚的书面传统，日常交谈则爱用昵称拉近距离。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_VERESK_DESCRIPTION.en: Consonant clusters and changing noun endings give this language a distinctive rhythm. Poetry and letters sustain its written tradition, while affectionate names bring conversation closer.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_DESCRIPTION.source: 北方港口与小镇通行的语言。复合词可以把几个意思接在一起，语调的起伏让相近的词听来各有区别。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 北方港口与小镇通行的语言。复合词可以把几个意思接在一起，语调的起伏让相近的词听来各有区别。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_LINDAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Spoken in northern ports and small towns. Compound words join ideas together, while pitch gives similar-sounding words their own contours.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_MARASU_DESCRIPTION.source: 群岛之间往来的商人和旅客把它带到各个码头。词根加上前后缀就能换一种用法，重叠的词语也常出现在闲谈里。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_MARASU_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 群岛之间往来的商人和旅客把它带到各个码头。词根加上前后缀就能换一种用法，重叠的词语也常出现在闲谈里。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_MARASU_DESCRIPTION.en: Traders and travellers carry it between island harbours. Prefixes and suffixes give roots new uses, and repeated words are common in everyday talk.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_DESCRIPTION.source: 曾随移民横渡大洋，如今在许多城市有了各自的口音。动词的变化交代人物和时间，问句与感叹句在纸上也有鲜明的起落。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 曾随移民横渡大洋，如今在许多城市有了各自的口音。动词的变化交代人物和时间，问句与感叹句在纸上也有鲜明的起落。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_SERRANOVA_DESCRIPTION.en: Carried across the ocean by migrants, it has developed distinct city accents. Verb endings locate speakers and events in time, and its written questions and exclamations have clear beginnings and endings.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_DESCRIPTION.source: 沿海集市和内陆商路上都能听见它。名词分成不同类别，句中的修饰语随之呼应，外来词也在长久的往来中落下脚来。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 沿海集市和内陆商路上都能听见它。名词分成不同类别，句中的修饰语随之呼应，外来词也在长久的往来中落下脚来。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_ORUVIA_DESCRIPTION.en: Heard in coastal markets and along inland trade routes. Noun classes echo through the words around them, alongside borrowings left by generations of contact.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_DESCRIPTION.source: 书写从右向左铺开，许多词围绕一组辅音词根生长。朗读的书面语与街巷里的口语各有节奏，故事常在人声之间流传。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 书写从右向左铺开，许多词围绕一组辅音词根生长。朗读的书面语与街巷里的口语各有节奏，故事常在人声之间流传。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_NASHIR_DESCRIPTION.en: Written from right to left, with many words built around consonant roots. Formal readings and street conversation have different rhythms, and stories travel readily by voice.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_DESCRIPTION.source: 元音清楚，句子常随着重音舒展。地方口音伴着市集、戏剧和歌声流动，书面语把许多城镇的读者联系在一起。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 元音清楚，句子常随着重音舒展。地方口音伴着市集、戏剧和歌声流动，书面语把许多城镇的读者联系在一起。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_SOLERIA_DESCRIPTION.en: Clear vowels and strong stresses let sentences unfold. Local accents travel through markets, theatre and song, while the written language connects readers across towns.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_DESCRIPTION.source: 海峡两岸的口音一路传到远方。古老的词、航海用语和城市俚语挤在同一部词典里，日常说法又随地方而变。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 海峡两岸的口音一路传到远方。古老的词、航海用语和城市俚语挤在同一部词典里，日常说法又随地方而变。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_AVENDON_DESCRIPTION.en: Accents from the channel have travelled far. Old words, nautical terms and city slang share the same dictionaries, with everyday usage varying from place to place.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_DESCRIPTION.source: 复合词能把长长的概念收进一个词里，名词和冠词的变化标明句中的关系。严整的书面句式之外，各地口语保留着自己的声调。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 复合词能把长长的概念收进一个词里，名词和冠词的变化标明句中的关系。严整的书面句式之外，各地口语保留着自己的声调。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_RHENIVIA_DESCRIPTION.en: Compounds gather long ideas into single words, while nouns and articles mark relationships within a sentence. Local speech keeps its own sounds alongside the structured written language.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_DESCRIPTION.source: 文字从右向左连缀，诗句常借节奏与押韵记在人们心里。日常表达中的敬语、借词和委婉说法，沿着古老商道传到别处。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 文字从右向左连缀，诗句常借节奏与押韵记在人们心里。日常表达中的敬语、借词和委婉说法，沿着古老商道传到别处。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_MEHRAN_DESCRIPTION.en: Its letters join from right to left, and rhythm and rhyme help poetry stay in memory. Polite forms, borrowed words and indirect phrasing have travelled along old trade routes.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_DESCRIPTION.source: 远航者带来的语言在南方长出了新口音。简称、绰号和本地词进入日常交谈，旷野与港口的故事都有人用它讲述。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 远航者带来的语言在南方长出了新口音。简称、绰号和本地词进入日常交谈，旷野与港口的故事都有人用它讲述。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_CANTALIA_DESCRIPTION.en: A language brought by voyagers and reshaped by southern accents. Short forms, nicknames and local words colour everyday speech, carrying stories of the bush and the harbours.

LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_DESCRIPTION.source: 街市、铁路和城市间的往来让这门语言广为人知。名词有性的区别，动词随人物与时态变化，口语里还保留着许多来自邻近语言的词。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 街市、铁路和城市间的往来让这门语言广为人知。名词有性的区别，动词随人物与时态变化，口语里还保留着许多来自邻近语言的词。
LOC_WORLD_LANGUAGE_VISHARA_DESCRIPTION.en: Markets, railways and travel between cities have carried it widely. Nouns have gender, verbs change with speakers and time, and everyday speech holds many words from neighbouring languages.

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WORKERS_DES.source: 按播种和收获安排日子的人。天气、收购价和下一季的投入，常比日历更能决定他们什么时候忙。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WORKERS_DES.zh_CN: 按播种和收获安排日子的人。天气、收购价和下一季的投入，常比日历更能决定他们什么时候忙。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WORKERS_DES.en: People whose days follow sowing and harvest. Weather, crop prices and next season's costs often matter more than the calendar.

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKERS_DESCR.source: 在车间与生产线上交接班的人，熟悉机器的声响，也在意工时、工资和岗位的变化。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKERS_DESCR.zh_CN: 在车间与生产线上交接班的人，熟悉机器的声响，也在意工时、工资和岗位的变化。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKERS_DESCR.en: Shift workers in workshops and on production lines. They know the sound of their machines and watch changes to hours, pay and jobs.

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_DESCRIPT.source: 从开门营业忙到送走最后一位客人。排班、客流和顾客的评价会穿进他们下班后的聊天。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_DESCRIPT.zh_CN: 从开门营业忙到送走最后一位客人。排班、客流和顾客评价，也是下班后的话题。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_DESCRIPT.en: Their working day runs from opening time to the last customer. Rotas, busy periods and customer reviews follow them into conversations after work.

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_DESCRIPTI.source: 照看病人、安排治疗的人，有人值夜班，有人跑社区。诊室里的经历和交接时的消息，把分散的同事连在一起。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_DESCRIPTI.zh_CN: 照看病人、安排治疗的人，有人值夜班，有人跑社区。诊室里的经历和交接时的消息，把分散的同事连在一起。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_DESCRIPTI.en: People caring for patients and arranging treatment, from night shifts to community visits. Experiences in consulting rooms and handover notes connect colleagues who rarely meet.

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_EDUCATORS_DESCRIPTION.source: 把知识讲给别人听的人。备课、答疑和改作业之外，他们也讨论学生的处境和教学里遇到的难题。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_EDUCATORS_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 把知识讲给别人听的人。备课、答疑和改作业之外，他们也讨论学生的处境和教学里遇到的难题。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_EDUCATORS_DESCRIPTION.en: People who make knowledge understandable. Beyond preparing lessons and marking work, they talk about students' lives and the problems that teaching brings.

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_DESCRIPTI.source: 守着摊位或小店谋生的人，常客的习惯、房租和进货账都记在心里。街坊一句话，有时比广告传得快。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_DESCRIPTI.zh_CN: 守着摊位或小店谋生的人，常客的习惯、房租和进货账都记在心里。街坊一句话，有时比广告传得快。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_DESCRIPTI.en: People making a living from stalls and small shops. They remember regular customers, rent dates and supplier bills. A neighbour's word can travel faster than an advert.

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_DESCRIPTION.source: 与设备、软件和技术系统打交道的人。工具更新得很快，故障、经验和招工消息在同行之间流转。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 与设备、软件和技术系统打交道的人。工具更新得很快，故障、经验和招工消息在同行之间流转。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_DESCRIPTION.en: People working with equipment, software and technical systems. Tools change quickly; faults, practical advice and job leads circulate among peers.

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_RETIREES_DESCRIPTION.source: 从固定工作中退下来，重新安排日常生活的人。有人照顾家人，有人参加社区活动，旧同事和邻居仍是重要的消息来源。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_RETIREES_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 从固定工作中退下来，重新安排日常生活的人。有人照顾家人，有人参加社区活动，旧同事和邻居仍是重要的消息来源。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_RETIREES_DESCRIPTION.en: People rebuilding their routines after leaving regular work. Family care, community activities, former colleagues and neighbours keep their days connected.

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_DIASPORAS_DESCRIPTION.source: 在别处生活，同时与故乡保持往来的人。聊天群里的消息跨着时区，语言和习惯也在新生活里慢慢变化。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_DIASPORAS_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 在别处生活，同时与故乡保持往来的人。聊天群里的消息跨着时区，语言和习惯也在新生活里慢慢变化。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_DIASPORAS_DESCRIPTION.en: People living elsewhere while keeping ties with home. Their group messages cross time zones, and their language and habits change with their new lives.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HOUSING_DESCRIPTION.source: 从租金、搬家到买房，围绕住处作出的选择。房间的大小、离工作的远近和每月的账单都在里面。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HOUSING_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 从租房、搬家到买房，房间大小、离工作的远近和每月账单，都影响着住处的选择。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HOUSING_DESCRIPTION.en: Choices about finding somewhere to live: rent, moving, buying, space, the journey to work and the monthly bill.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_DESCRIPTION.source: 身体出了什么问题，去哪里求助，治疗要花多少钱。挂号、用药和照顾病人的经验很容易引出长谈。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 身体出了什么问题，去哪里求助，治疗要花多少钱。挂号、用药和照顾病人的经验很容易引出长谈。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_DESCRIPTION.en: What is wrong, where to seek help and how to pay for treatment. Appointments, medicines and caring for someone can start long conversations.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CLIMATE_DESCRIPTION.source: 人们如何应对天气与环境的长期变化，也谈眼前的酷暑、雨季和身边的河流。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CLIMATE_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 人们如何应对天气与环境的长期变化，也谈眼前的酷暑、雨季和身边的河流。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CLIMATE_DESCRIPTION.en: How people live with long-term changes in weather and the environment, alongside this summer's heat, the rains and the river nearby.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_ENERGY_DESCRIPTION.source: 灯为什么会熄，油价为什么又变了。电力、燃料与供给的选择，最后都会落到生产和生活的开销上。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_ENERGY_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 灯为什么会熄，油价为什么又变了。电力、燃料与供给的选择，最后都会落到生产和生活的开销上。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_ENERGY_DESCRIPTION.en: Why the lights went out or fuel prices changed again. Decisions about power and supply become costs in working and everyday life.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_FOOD_DESCRIPTION.source: 从田地到餐桌，一顿饭经过许多人的手。口味、食材价格、供应和收成都能成为谈话的起点。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_FOOD_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 从田地到餐桌，一顿饭经过许多人的手。口味、食材价格、供应和收成都能成为谈话的起点。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_FOOD_DESCRIPTION.en: A meal passes through many hands on its way from field to table. Taste, ingredient prices, supplies and harvests all give people something to discuss.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_DESCRIPTION.source: 怎样准时到达，又怎样把东西送到。通勤、公共交通和货运把不同地方的人接在同一张时间表上。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 怎样准时到达，又怎样把东西送到。通勤、公共交通和货运把不同地方的人接在同一张时间表上。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_DESCRIPTION.en: Getting people and goods where they need to be. Commuting, public transport and freight connect distant places through shared timetables.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_MIGRATION_DESCRIPTION.source: 离开熟悉的地方，到新的住处开始生活。手续、工作、家人和远方的联系，常常同时悬在心上。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_MIGRATION_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 离开熟悉的地方，到新的住处开始生活。手续、工作、家人和远方的联系，常常同时悬在心上。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_MIGRATION_DESCRIPTION.en: Leaving a familiar place and starting life somewhere new. Paperwork, work, family and ties across distance often compete for attention.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TOURISM_DESCRIPTION.source: 暂时去别处看看的人，与在那里过日子的人相遇。路线、住宿、风景和接待游客的生意都由此展开。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TOURISM_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 暂时去别处看看的人，与在那里过日子的人相遇。路线、住宿、风景和接待游客的生意都由此展开。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TOURISM_DESCRIPTION.en: Visitors meet people living their ordinary lives elsewhere. Routes, rooms, scenery and the businesses serving travellers grow around those encounters.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRADE_DESCRIPTION.source: 货物从哪里来，价格由谁谈，能否按约定送到。跨境买卖也把港口、工厂和商店的日子联系起来。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRADE_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 货物从哪里来，价格由谁谈，能否按约定送到。跨境买卖也把港口、工厂和商店的日子联系起来。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRADE_DESCRIPTION.en: Where goods come from, who agrees the price and whether deliveries arrive as promised. Trade links the working days of ports, factories and shops.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_SCIENCE_DESCRIPTION.source: 提出问题，再拿观察和实验去检验。新发现怎样被解释、谁来相信，也是讨论的一部分。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_SCIENCE_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 提出问题，再拿观察和实验去检验。新发现怎样被解释、谁来相信，也是讨论的一部分。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_SCIENCE_DESCRIPTION.en: Questions tested through observation and experiment. How discoveries are explained, and who believes them, is part of the conversation too.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CARE_DESCRIPTION.source: 日常照顾怎样分担，时间又从哪里来。育儿、养老和病中陪伴，把家里的事带进了公共讨论。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CARE_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 日常照顾怎样分担，时间又从哪里来。育儿、养老和病中陪伴，把家里的事带进了公共讨论。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CARE_DESCRIPTION.en: Sharing the daily work of looking after others, and finding the time. Childcare, elder care and supporting someone through illness bring household questions into public discussion.

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_DESCRIPTIO.source: 街道和社区怎样让人安心生活。事故、治安与应急准备，会把平时互不相识的人聚到一起。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_DESCRIPTIO.zh_CN: 街道和社区怎样让人安心生活。事故、治安与应急准备，会把平时互不相识的人聚到一起。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_DESCRIPTIO.en: What makes streets and neighbourhoods feel safe to live in. Accidents, crime and preparing for emergencies can bring strangers together.

Dante Alighieri, Divine Comedy, Inferno, canto I (Italian)

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WORKERS_NOT.source: 收购站门口的价目表被雨浸湿了，新的数字直接写在旧价上。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WORKERS_NOT.zh_CN:
“锄禾日当午，汗滴禾下土。”
李绅《悯农二首·其二》
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_AGRICULTURAL_WORKERS_NOT.en:
“Hoeing grain at noon, sweat falls onto the soil.”
Li Shen, Compassion for the Peasants, II

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKERS_NOTE.source: 交班簿上夹着一张纸：第三台机器今天还是那个响声。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKERS_NOTE.zh_CN:
“记住，时间就是金钱。”
本杰明·富兰克林《给年轻商人的忠告》（1748）
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_INDUSTRIAL_WORKERS_NOTE.en:
“Remember that time is money.”
Benjamin Franklin, Advice to a Young Tradesman (1748)

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_NOTE.source: 关店前还剩一张没擦的桌子，末班车快到了。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_NOTE.zh_CN:
“按你的方式来。”
汉堡王广告语 Have It Your Way（1974）
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SERVICE_WORKERS_NOTE.en:
“Have it your way.”
Burger King advertising slogan (1974)

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_NOTE.source: 值班表边缘写满换班的名字，有一个名字被圈了两次。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_NOTE.zh_CN:
“不应伤害病人。”
弗洛伦斯·南丁格尔《医院笔记》（1863），摘译
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_HEALTH_WORKERS_NOTE.en:
“it should do the sick no harm.”
Florence Nightingale, Notes on Hospitals (1863), excerpt

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_EDUCATORS_NOTE.source: 讲义最后一页留着半道题，旁边写着：明天接着讲。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_EDUCATORS_NOTE.zh_CN:
“三人行，必有我师焉。”
《论语·述而》
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_EDUCATORS_NOTE.en:
“When three walk together, I can surely find a teacher among them.”
The Analects, Shu Er

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_NOTE.source: 账本里有一页只记着赊账的姓氏，熟客来了才添全名。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_NOTE.zh_CN:
“货恶其弃于地也，不必藏于己。”
《礼记·礼运》
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_SMALL_BUSINESS_NOTE.en:
“People dislike goods going to waste; they need not keep them for themselves.”
Book of Rites, Li Yun

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_NOTE.source: 问题单终于关闭，评论区又多了一句：我这里也复现了。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_NOTE.zh_CN:
“空谈很廉价，给我看代码。”
林纳斯·托瓦兹，Linux 内核邮件列表（2000）
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_TECH_WORKERS_NOTE.en:
“Talk is cheap. Show me the code.”
Linus Torvalds, Linux kernel mailing list (2000)

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_RETIREES_NOTE.source: 合唱队把排练改到了周四，通知贴在一张旧节目单的背面。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_RETIREES_NOTE.zh_CN:
“老吾老，以及人之老。”
《孟子·梁惠王上》
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_RETIREES_NOTE.en:
“Care for your own elders, and extend that care to the elders of others.”
Mencius, Liang Hui Wang I

LOC_WORLD_GROUP_DIASPORAS_NOTE.source: 一个人说早安，另一个人刚准备关灯。
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_DIASPORAS_NOTE.zh_CN:
“举头望明月，低头思故乡。”
李白《静夜思》
LOC_WORLD_GROUP_DIASPORAS_NOTE.en:
“I raise my head to the bright moon, then lower it, thinking of home.”
Li Bai, Quiet Night Thoughts

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HOUSING_NOTE.source: 看房时拍的照片里，窗户外面刚好经过一列火车。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HOUSING_NOTE.zh_CN:
“安得广厦千万间，大庇天下寒士俱欢颜！”
杜甫《茅屋为秋风所破歌》
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HOUSING_NOTE.en:
“If only there were countless spacious homes to shelter all the poor in joy!”
Du Fu, My Thatched Roof Is Ruined by the Autumn Wind

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_NOTE.source: 候诊单上的号码又往前跳了一格。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_NOTE.zh_CN:

中共十七大报告（2007）
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_HEALTHCARE_NOTE.en:
“Medical care for the sick.”
Report to the 17th National Congress of the CPC (2007)

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CLIMATE_NOTE.source: 往年的水位线留在桥墩上，今年的线又高了一点。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CLIMATE_NOTE.zh_CN:
“你们怎么敢！”
格蕾塔·通贝里，联合国气候行动峰会演讲（2019）
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CLIMATE_NOTE.en:
“How dare you!”
Greta Thunberg, UN Climate Action Summit speech (2019)

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_ENERGY_NOTE.source: 停电通知压在冰箱贴下面。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_ENERGY_NOTE.zh_CN:
“把力量交给人民！”
约翰·列侬《Power to the People》（1971）
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_ENERGY_NOTE.en:
“Power to the people!”
John Lennon, Power to the People (1971)

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_FOOD_NOTE.source: 食谱上的用量改了三回，只有盐那一栏写着少许。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_FOOD_NOTE.zh_CN:
“民人以食为天。”
班固《汉书·郦陆朱刘叔孙传》
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_FOOD_NOTE.en:
“The people regard food as their heaven.”
Ban Gu, Book of Han, biographies of Li, Lu, Zhu, Liu and Shusun

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_NOTE.source: 站牌上贴着临时改道的箭头。

电影《回到未来》（1985）
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRANSPORT_NOTE.en:
“Roads? Where we’re going, we don’t need roads.”
Back to the Future (1985)

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_MIGRATION_NOTE.source: 行李里最先拿出来的是插头转换器。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_MIGRATION_NOTE.zh_CN:

约翰·多恩《沉思录》第17篇（1624）
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_MIGRATION_NOTE.en:
“No man is an island.”
John Donne, Meditation XVII (1624)

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TOURISM_NOTE.source: 明信片寄出时，寄信的人已经到家了。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TOURISM_NOTE.zh_CN:

顾少强辞职信，2015年新闻报道
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TOURISM_NOTE.en:
“The world is so big. I want to go and see it.”
Gu Shaoqiang’s resignation letter, reported in the news in 2015

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRADE_NOTE.source: 箱子上的目的地盖了新章，旧地址还能辨认出来。
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRADE_NOTE.zh_CN:
“让世界准时送达。”
联邦快递广告语 The World on Time
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_TRADE_NOTE.en:
“The World on Time.”
FedEx advertising slogan

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_SCIENCE_NOTE.zh_CN:
“求知若饥，虚心若愚。”
史蒂夫·乔布斯，斯坦福大学毕业演讲（2005），引《全球概览》封底
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_SCIENCE_NOTE.en:
“Stay hungry. Stay foolish.”
Steve Jobs, Stanford commencement speech (2005), quoting The Whole Earth Catalog

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CARE_NOTE.zh_CN:

孟郊《游子吟》
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_CARE_NOTE.en:
“How can a blade of grass repay the warmth of spring?”
Meng Jiao, Song of the Travelling Son

LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_NOTE.zh_CN:
“独自前往太危险了！拿上这个。”
游戏《塞尔达传说》（1986）
LOC_WORLD_TOPIC_PUBLIC_SAFETY_NOTE.en:
“It’s dangerous to go alone! Take this.”
The Legend of Zelda (1986)
